ros_architecture: Isaac bundled Python 3.11 bridge communicates via DDS with external apt ROS Python 3.10

process_architecture.command_world_scope: Each command starts a fresh rack-v1 scene at HOME; one selected container from shelf A, B or C is transferred with the right arm via the tray to the outbound table.
process_architecture.physics: Conda Python3.11; Isaac CPU PhysX and RTX rendering
process_architecture.global_planner: Actual external apt ROS2 Humble ComputePathToPose in system Python3.10
process_architecture.llm: Pinned Qwen3-4B Q4_K_M GGUF, llama.cpp CUDA; owned server stops before Isaac starts

execution_assumptions: The transport template uses the right arm; arm self-collision is disabled.
Derived finger pad colliders only; complete finger metal/housing collision is not validated.
Fixed rear support skids, friction 0.02 and min combine; not articulated casters.
GT base localization and camera world pose/extrinsics; RGB ArUco/PnP object estimates.
Project ideal planar PhysX raycast LiDAR; no noise/reflection/delay model or stock-sensor claim.
One 40x50x60 mm, 100 g free rigid object; 1 kg tray and generic 100 g wrist camera mount.
No object attachment, gravity removal or execution-time object pose override.
2 ms physics / 20 ms QP commands are design intervals, not a hard real-time guarantee.
